author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be the dumbest application for Gemini I've seen, taking historical maps and deciding to let you generate seemingly whatever you want. Why would Google think this is a good idea? Let's try and figure it out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: The Stupidest Thing Google Ever Done...
